shorts.title: I Raced a Hippo 🦛 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
Hippos can't actually swim. A hippo can close its nostrils and ears underwater.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Hippopotamus: Tommy Andriollo (CC BY), CC0, martin ingemansson (CC BY), Annika Lindqvist (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Did you know hippos can't float? 👇

shorts.title: I Tried to Outrow a Moose 🫎 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
A moose can swim for two hours. Moose have been seen swimming more than ten miles to reach food.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: I Picked Up a Cone Snail 🐚 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
This snail hunts fish with insulin. Scientists are studying cone snail insulin for faster-acting diabetes medicine.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Geography cone snail: Kai Squires (CC BY); California cone snail: Cricket Raspet (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Would you ever pick up a pretty shell again? 👇

shorts.title: I Brought a Komodo Dragon a Snack 🦎 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
This lizard can eat most of its weight. Komodo dragons can go weeks without eating between big meals.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Komodo dragon: PampaSorro (CC BY), CC0, Jason Alexander (CC BY), rjtizard (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: What's the most you've ever eaten in one sitting? 👇

shorts.title: I Tried to Hug a Piranha 🐟 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
Piranhas group up because they're scared. Only a couple of the roughly 25 piranha species are known to bark.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Red-bellied piranha: CC0, CK2AZ (CC BY), Bailey Duncan (CC BY), zebedeugalinha (CC BY), Nico Hernandez (CC BY), Julien Lepage (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Did movies ruin piranhas for you? 👇

shorts.title: I Held the Croc Bite Sensor 🐊 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
This croc has the strongest bite measured. The previous record holder was an American alligator.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: I High-Fived a Blue-Ringed Octopus 🐙 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
This octopus bite can be painless. It's small enough to fit in your palm, which is exactly why you shouldn't pick one up.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Greater blue-ringed octopus: Gregor Bailar (CC BY), desertnaturalist (CC BY), Kai Squires (CC BY); Southern blue-ringed octopus: Peter Crowcroft (CC BY), Christopher Mark (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Did you know the bite might not even hurt? 👇
